text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My training volume was simply 
insufficient. In that case, I just need to 
increase it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let it end like this.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure we don't overdo it.

Keep that spirit up and let's win the next 
one!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That goes for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I know. I've seen the lights in the 
Trainer's Office staying on late into the 
night.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...That is why I wish to do my best, too. 
That is how I truly feel."
choice_data_list:
Then let's both do our best without 
overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You're full of motivation too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy. To see you getting this 
passionate about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Getting so fired up that you stiffen 
up. Fufu. We're both equally serious, 
aren't we?"
